justification: No matching title found on legislation.govt.nz's title search or anywhere on the wider web. The closest real candidate, 'Health Sector (Transfers) Act 1993' (No 23), has a different name entirely. Assessed as a mis-captured descriptive phrase from the original citation extraction (about the 1990s health-sector reforms generally), not a real, separately-citable document -- the same class of issue as the invalid_name exclusion category applied earlier in the pipeline (sg2_step4/step14).

Confirmed via web search to be a real NZ Gazette notice (gazette.govt.nz/notice/id/2003-au5133), published on the Gazette system rather than legislation.govt.nz. No structured PCO XML exists for it, so this pipeline's XML-based amendment/citation extraction cannot process it regardless of identifier assignment. This is a pipeline scope limitation (Gazette notices are outside the legislation.govt.nz PCO XML corpus), NOT an extraction error -- the candidate itself is genuine and was correctly identified as relevant.
